stem:
Gauri wants a balanced social life during adolescence. She chats with friends face to face and also posts in a class group online.

Which claim correctly decides what counts as part of that balanced social life?

options.text: Respectful interaction and responsible online posts, including not sharing a classmate's private information without permission, are part of a balanced social life.
Sharing a classmate's private information without permission is responsible if the information is accurate.
Online posts do not count, because only face-to-face talk is part of a balanced social life.
A friendly class group guarantees that every post in it is responsible.

teacher.key_rationale: Balanced social life includes respectful online behaviour and consent when sharing private information. Accuracy alone is not enough, online conduct counts, and a friendly group does not certify every post.
